kicker: PS & XBOX STORES · AS OF NOV 17
title: GTA 6 pre-order record: what's real and what's not
yt_title: GTA 6 broke the PS & Xbox pre-order record… but how many? 💰
description: But how many? Sony and Microsoft confirmed GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store history, without numbers. Take-Two's CEO only says pre-orders are tracking far in excess of expectations. Sensor Tower's 12M+ is an estimate (rumor); 15M / $1.45B is unverified, with no primary source (rumor); 'Rockstar confirmed $1B' is false.
tiktok_caption: GTA 6 broke the PS & Xbox pre-order record 💰 but how many? Most numbers going around are guesses. Did you pre-order? 👇

lines.text: GTA 6 broke a pre-order record. But how many?
